canonical.behaviour: Build the agreed plan of docs/plans/2026-11-17-plain-owner-questions (R1-R10, tickets T0-T10; GPT-6.1 Sol and the coordinator both accept it). Approving this offer also approves the plan. In plain words: every common writing rule moves into one file, skills/workflow/WRITING.md, and its check keeps the name Unslop; SIMPLE-ENGLISH.md keeps only its strict modes, credit and licence and points to WRITING.md; fixed word swaps and the contraction ban become suggestions everywhere they are enforced today; every place that writes something a person reads points to WRITING.md; every decision question leads with its meaning, uses numbered lettered choices with a recommendation, and keeps codes only as a reference at the end; a request to rewrite or simplify text uses the rules with no task files; a change only counts as small after it says what depends on it; the /spar start card offers only the launches left. Each ticket is built test first. The two report-read hooks are changed in a temporary separate copy (D:/workflow-axa-hook-candidate) and copied back only after their tests pass, because this session runs the hooks from D:/workflow-axa. After the full suite, validate and a review by GPT-6.1 Sol and a fresh Claude pass, the work is committed and pushed to main. Live checks are not part of this offer: they get their own question with a cap.
exclusions: no change to application UI copy, error messages or translations, or to Strict mode's rules
no change to old task records, archives, quoted owner answers or already-presented approvals
no live or paid run; those get their own question with a cap
no version bump, CHANGELOG or release; rc.3 is a separate step
the installed plugin and the Codex copies stay untouched
conditions: T0's sorted list is recorded before any other file changes
each ticket's new tests fail before its change and pass after; no assertion is deleted to get a pass
the commit and push only after the full suite, validate and the review by GPT-6.1 Sol and a fresh Claude pass
the hooks change only in D:/workflow-axa-hook-candidate until their tests pass there; the copy is deleted afterwards
checks: every R9 check in one test entry point
full suite: python -X utf8 -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py"
review: GPT-6.1 Sol and a fresh Claude Opus 5.5, until both pass
